Description: Isolated regulated DC/DC 5V to single 15V 1W 67mA (NOT the 0523 which is dual +/-15V at 33mA)
Purpose: Standalone 15V rail that holds 15V +/-5% without a bench supply. Budget: 4004 40mA + 3x LM2901 6mA max + CD4504 + leakage. No static pull-up current after the 2.7 redesign
RetroShield reference rail; measure its drift against DC1
Rail clamp (abs max is 20V below VSS)
Dummy load 15mA each for DMM rail tests

Open-drain low side: TEST + RESET (10k pull-up) + 4 bus lines + 4 spares. Gates from 5V AHCT541 (3.3V not enough for a 3.0V threshold part). NOT used on clocks: Coss 20pF would force a 450 ohm pull-up

Description: P-channel MOSFET 60V 7 ohm max at VGS -5V
Purpose: High side of tri-state bus driver x4 + 2 spares. Gate from CD4504B at 0/15V (VGS max +/-20V)
Six channels: phi1 + phi2 driven directly (40ns typ 80ns max into 50pF per cd4504b.pdf) + 4 P-FET gates. Second part is the spare since all six channels are used
3.3V FPGA to 5V: 6 BS170 gates + 6 CD4504 inputs = 12 of 16 channels
All 9 4004 outputs. Runs from +15V so the reference can sit at 11.5V (VICR max is VCC-2V). Open collector pulled to 3.3V. 0.3us typ response at this overdrive
Fallback for 2 bus lines if LM2901 proves too slow. Needs 2:1 divider on the signal and 5.75V reference (differential input abs max +/-5V). 8mA typ per package
4004 socket for test board and final board
